chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from 'Ali ibn Muhammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Muhammad ibn 'Abd Allah, who said:
I asked al-Rida عليه السلام about the ghusl of Friday, and he said: It is obligatory upon every male and female, whether free or slave.

key_terms.أُنْثَى: female person included in the ruling
key_terms.حُرٍّ: a free person, explicitly covered by the ruling
key_terms.ذَكَرٍ: male person included in the ruling
key_terms.عَبْدٍ: an enslaved person, explicitly covered by the ruling
key_terms.وَاجِبٌ: obligatory; legally required in the wording of the report
key_terms.يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ: Friday, the day for which this ghusl is prescribed

ai.seo_question: Is the Friday ghusl obligatory for all Muslims according to this hadith from Imam al-Rida عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a ruling from Imam al-Rida عليه السلام concerning the Friday ghusl. It states its obligation in universal terms, applying to males and females alike, whether free or enslaved, indicating the broad scope of this devotional ruling.
